injuries.note: Murray will miss the remainder of the season due to an elbow injury, Demetrius Harvey of The Florida Times-Union reports.

injuries.name: DaVon Hamilton

injuries.note: Jaguars coach Liam Coen confirmed Monday that Hamilton will miss the remainder of the season after suffering a torn quadriceps in Sunday's win over the Colts, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

injuries.name: Lamar Jackson

injuries.note: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills that Jackson will undergo surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve,  Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
